main.usage_block:
Lege - Document Processing CLI

Interactive mode:
    lege

Non-interactive processing:
    lege <file.pdf> [more.pdf ...] [page-range] [target] [options...]

Other commands:
    lege --help
    lege --help debug            # show debug/data-generation modes
    lege --status
    lege --licenses
    lege --targets               # list built-in device presets

OPTIONS:
  Output format:
    --text-format <fmt>          ccitt4 (default), jbig2, or djvu
    --cover-format <fmt>         jpeg (default), jp2, ccitt4, jbig2, or none
    --djvu-quality <1-100>       DjVu IW44 quality (default: 75)

  Binarization:
    --binarization <method>      adaptive, fixed (default), or heavy
    --threshold <0-255>          Fixed threshold value (default: 200)
    --sauvola-k <0.0-1.0>        Sauvola k-factor for adaptive binarization

  Processing toggles:
    --dither                     Enable Stucki dithering for image regions
    --no-layout                  Disable ONNX layout detection model
    --ocr                        Enable OCR text layer
    --no-ocr                     Disable OCR text layer
    --no-cover                   Skip separate cover page treatment
    --pdf-compat                 Disable object streams (PDF 1.4 compat)
    --invert                     Invert grayscale before processing
    --symbol-mode                Enable lossy JBIG2 symbol mode
    --halftone                   Enable JBIG2 halftone for image regions
    --deskew                     Enable deskew (rotation/unwarp correction)
    --high-quality               Higher quality output (DjVu IW44 100)
    --image-only                 Image-only mode (skip binarization)
    --original-images            Keep original image quality

  Margin processing:
    --center-margins             Standardize and center content on page
    --crop-margins               Crop to content and resize
    --force-crop                 Crop margins including footnotes

  Output:
    --output <dir>               Output directory (default: same as input)
    --language <code>             OCR language code (Linux only)

  Debug / data-generation:
    --pdf-to-png <height>        Rasterize PDF pages to PNG at given height
    --crop-areas <text|image|both>  Extract layout detection regions
    --png-folder                 Process a folder of PNGs (inference mode)
    --format <png|jpg>           Output format for --crop-areas

PAGE-RANGE FORMS:
    1-10, 5, all

TARGET FORMS:
    Number (e.g. 1600), WIDTHxHEIGHT (e.g. 1440x1920), or device name

EXAMPLES:
    lege book.pdf
    lege book.pdf 1-10 --text-format jbig2 --dither
    lege book.pdf all 1440x1920 --binarization adaptive --sauvola-k 0.3
    lege book.pdf --text-format djvu --djvu-quality 100 --output ./out
    lege book.pdf --no-layout --invert --threshold 180
    lege book.pdf --crop-margins --deskew --ocr
    lege book.pdf --pdf-to-png 1600
    lege book.pdf --crop-areas image --output ./dataset --format jpg
    lege file1.pdf file2.pdf all --text-format jbig2
main.debug_help_block:
Lege - Debug Modes

All debug modes use the same unified --flag syntax as normal processing.

PDF to PNG (rasterize pages for inspection):
  Usage:   lege <file.pdf> [page_range] --pdf-to-png <height>
  Example: lege book.pdf 1-5 --pdf-to-png 1600

Crop detected layout regions from a PDF into separate images:
  Usage:   lege <file.pdf> [page_range] --crop-areas text|image|both [--output DIR] [--format png|jpg] [--deskew]
  Example: lege book.pdf all --crop-areas image --output ./dataset --format jpg --deskew
  Notes:
    - Regions are numbered per page: page_0001_area_001.jpg, etc.
    - Uses the same layout model as the main pipeline.
    - Output defaults to '<pdf_stem>_areas' next to the input if --output is omitted.

PNG folder inference (images instead of PDF):
  Usage:   lege <folder> --png-folder [--deskew] [--output DIR]
  Example: lege ./scans --png-folder --deskew
main.env_variables_help_block:
Lege - Environment Variables

Lege uses built-in production defaults and no longer requires runtime environment variables for pipeline behavior.

Expected deployment layout:
- Keep runtime DLLs (pdfium/onnxruntime/front_stage) next to the executable.
- Keep model assets in the executable directory or a models subdirectory.
- Keep OCR language data in a local tessdata directory when needed.
